theorems.name: Submission.canonicalCarrier_closed_support
theorems.statement: ApproxTangentAE → ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (V : RectifiableVarifold n ℓ) (U : Set (Ambient n ℓ)), 0 < n → IsOpen U → (∀ ξ ∈ U, V.HasDensityAt ξ (V.density ξ)) → UpperSemicontinuousOn V.density U → (∀ α : ℝ, 0 < α → ∃ C, IsClosed C ∧ {x | x ∈ V.canonicalCarrier U ∧ α ≤ V.density x} = C ∩ U) ∧ ∀ α : ℝ, 0 < α → V.MultiplicityGE α U → V.canonicalCarrier U = V.support ∩ U ∧ ∀ x ∈ V.canonicalCarrier U, α ≤ V.density x
